office_does: The treasurer collects property taxes and other county revenue, pays county warrants and invests county funds.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Treasurer Jennifer L. White, in office since 2023, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Clallam County Treasurer since 2023 and former chief deputy treasurer, with earlier court, corrections and law enforcement roles; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Says invested funds rose 240% and interest earnings grew more than eightfold under a conservative approach [S1]
Began a review of the county's banking relationship for lower fees and stronger fraud protection [S1]
Pledges expanded secure electronic payments and property-fraud safeguards [S1]
